tenderSchedule.title: Maintenance of CTD IT infrastructure in all its offices in the State
tenderSchedule.description: Maintenance of CTD IT infrastructure in all its offices in the State

tenderAddress.blockNumber: The Additional Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (e-Governance), Vanijya Therige Karyalaya-1,4th Floor, Gandhinagar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the Tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed maintenance of IT infrastructure project/ executed deployment IT resources contract to one or two Govt. Departments satisfactorily involving the deployment of a minimum of 50 resources every year in the area of IT and IT enabled services in last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) in the state of Karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relavent work order/purchase order and satisfactory certificates issued by Governent Departments

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have deployed IT Resources at all 30 Districts in the state of Karnataka for one or two government departments for the last 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of the certificates of rendering service of providing of IT resources should be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have executed single IT Project of value not less than Rs 200 lakhs in the past three financial years to two Govt Departments and provided minimum 200 skilled resources including Helpdesk & Call Center executives to any Government Department for last three financial years in the state of Karnataka

The bidder should furnish the documentary proof of having deployed 50 Technical resources including the following key Category resources at least for a period of three years in the state of Karnataka. 1.Project/Data center Manager.2.Team Leaders 3.Data base Administrators 4.System administrato 5.Software Engineer
The bidder should be a company registered under the Companies Act 1956 or a Limited Liability Firm registered under the LLP Act and having minimum 5 years of experience as Pvt Ltd Company/LLP
Bidder should hold valid GST registration certificate, Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by income tax department, PF, ESI certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN, EPF and ESI certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be blacklisted by the Government of Karnataka or any of its agencies for any reasons whatsoever and the bidder should not be blacklisted by Central/ any other State/UT Government or its agencies for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices as on the time of bidding

The Bidders should have Oracle / Microsoft and Networking competency and shall furnish the certificates in proof of its competency and must possess official partnership/Membership with Oracle or Microsoft or Cisco.
The bidder should have a Registered office in Bengaluru, Karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking from Company in Appendix 3 and other documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders should have executed AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) including Data Center in Karnataka to any government departments for three years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26), and should have good experience in Procurement of IT infra structure
Submission of Declaration of Acceptance of Terms & Conditions to e-Tender Notification in the given format
The Bidder should possess ISO Certification ISO: 9001:2015 & ISO 20000-1:2018 and have completed at least three years as on 31st March 2026.
Submission of Undertaking on Service Level Compliance in the given format
Submission of Undertaking on litigation(s) in the given format
Submission of undertaking that quoted price is in compliance with the minimum wages act of govt of Karnataka
Submission of Covering letter as required in the given format Appendix 1
Furnishing of the Power of Attorney

The bidder should have a total turnover of at least Rs 10 crore and a turnover of at least Rs 5 crore in the business of providing services of IT and IT enabled services for the last three years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from CA in Appendix 2
